text:
linh: Heads-up — I'm planning a config-only deploy at 17:30 PT today to adjust routing weights, per-tenant rate caps, and batching heuristics. Change window: 30m. Will do a staged canary (2% -> 20% -> 100%). @maria @cj can you ack?

maria: Ack — SRE will monitor. I'll watch p95/p99, queue depth, and error-rate. Set observability hooks and a manual pause if anything spikes.

cj: LGTM from infra. One ask: reduce tenant 'research' floor to 5r/s (from 10) to avoid noisy neighbors. Also keep the previous routing table pinned as fallback.

linh: Will pin fallback mapping and add rollback playbook. Config diff (high-level):
```
routing_policy:
  default_weight: 1.0
  overrides:
    research: 0.5
rate_limits:
  per_tenant_floor: 5
  per_tenant_ceiling: 200
batching:
  max_tokens: 2048
  preferred_batch_size: 32
timeouts:
  inference_timeout_ms: 12000
  router_idle_timeout_ms: 250
```

deploy-bot: deploy queued by linh for 2025-06-12T17:30:00Z. Dry-run: PASSED. Canary plan: 2% for 5m -> 20% for 10m -> full. Notifying engaged oncall.

kevin: Quick note — if canary p95 > 350ms or error-rate > 0.5% hold and rollback. Use runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/config-deploy

maria: I'll escalate oncall if either condition breaches. Adding alert thresholds now. :thumbsup:

cj: Add metric tag `config_change:20250612_grw` so we can slice telemetry in postmortem.

linh: Thanks all. Release notes to include: changed research tenant floor to 5r/s, adjusted routing weights, bumped preferred_batch_size to 32, longer inference timeout. No model bumps. Pinned previous route map as fallback. I'll push at 17:30 if no objections.

kevin: No objections from infra/security. Go ahead.

linh: launching in 10m. Will post status updates here.

deploy-bot: deployment started — canary at 2%.

maria: Observability: p95=290ms, error-rate=0.12%, queue_depth normal. Moving to 20% in 3m.

deploy-bot: canary -> 20% complete. No anomalies noted.

linh: Rolling to 100%.

deploy-bot: deployment succeeded. tag=config-change/20250612-grw

maria: Post-deploy check: all green. Closing window. :tada:
